sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点半给总统打电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 探索太空七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星的背后是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 上千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超大圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最强的队伍。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始单词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢一锅端食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝创刊175周年，助你理解世界，充分过好每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅即可享受特别优惠，网址为nytimes.com斜杠subscribe。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Rachel Abrams and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是瑞秋·艾布拉姆斯，这是《每日秀》。

sentences.en: Ladies and gentlemen, the president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 女士们先生们，美利坚合众国总统。

sentences.en: Last week, President Trump unveiled Trump Rx.
sentences.zh: 上周，特朗普总统推出了“特朗普处方药网”。

sentences.en: Dozens of the most commonly used prescription drugs will be available at dramatic discounts for all consumers throughout a new website.
sentences.zh: 通过一个新网站，数十种最常用的处方药将以大幅折扣向所有消费者提供。

sentences.en: It's called TrumpRx.gov.
sentences.zh: 它叫TrumpRx.gov。

sentences.en: The administration's answer to the high cost of prescription drugs.
sentences.zh: 这是政府应对高昂处方药价格的解决方案。

sentences.en: This launch represents the largest reduction in prescription drug prices in history by many, many times.
sentences.zh: 这次推出代表了历史上最大幅度的处方药价格下调，成倍、成倍地下调。

sentences.en: And it's not even close.
sentences.zh: 而且根本没法比。

sentences.en: You're going to see numbers that you're not going to believe.
sentences.zh: 你会看到连你想都不敢想的数字。

sentences.en: The president hailed the website as a, quote, transformative health care initiative.
sentences.zh: 总统赞扬该网站是一项“具有变革意义的医疗保健举措”。

sentences.en: Congratulations to you on all that money you're saving.
sentences.zh: 恭喜你们省下了这么多钱。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you very much, everybody.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家。

sentences.en: Appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 感激不尽。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Margot Sanger-Katz explains how the site works and whether it will actually save Americans money.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事玛戈·桑格-卡茨将解释该网站的工作原理以及它是否真的能为美国人省钱。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, February 11.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月11日，星期三。

sentences.en: Margot, welcome back to the show.
sentences.zh: 玛戈，欢迎回到节目中。

sentences.en: It's nice to be back.
sentences.zh: 很高兴回来。

sentences.en: I feel like I have been hearing about this Trump Rx thing for probably months now without having a good sense of what this thing actually was.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我可能听说了好几个月关于这个“特朗普处方药网”的事，但一直不太清楚这东西到底是什么。

sentences.en: Like, I didn't know if it was an online pharmacy, a Trump-branded online pharmacy, perhaps.
sentences.zh: 比如，我不知道它是不是一个在线药房，也许是一个带有特朗普品牌的在线药房。

sentences.en: And last week, the website was actually unveiled.
sentences.zh: 而上周，这个网站终于正式亮相了。

sentences.en: So, Margot, start off by telling us, what is Trump Rx?
sentences.zh: 所以，玛戈，先给我们讲讲，什么是“特朗普处方药网”？

sentences.en: So, I think in some ways it's easier to say what it's not.
sentences.zh: 所以，我觉得从某种程度上来说，说它不是什么更容易一些。

sentences.en: It's not a place that you can buy prescription drugs.
sentences.zh: 它不是一个你可以购买处方药的地方。

sentences.en: This is not a pharmacy.
sentences.zh: 这不是一家药房。

sentences.en: It is not a store that's run by the federal government.
sentences.zh: 它不是由联邦政府运营的商店。

sentences.en: Instead, it's a place that you can go if you're looking to buy certain prescription drugs.
sentences.zh: 相反，如果你想买某些处方药，这是一个你可以去的地方。

sentences.en: It will help you figure out how to get them at a discounted price.
sentences.zh: 它会帮你弄清楚如何以折扣价买到这些药。

sentences.en: So, this is the federal government's effort to help you find drugs at a good price, but not to sell you drugs directly.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是联邦政府努力帮大家找到好价格的药物，但不是直接向你售药。

sentences.en: Which is so interesting because I'm pretty sure that pretty much every presidential candidate
sentences.zh: 这太有趣了，因为我很确定我这一生中几乎每一位总统候选人

sentences.en: in my lifetime has talked at some point and in some form about bringing down drug prices.
sentences.zh: 都在某个时候、以某种形式谈论过降低药价。

sentences.en: And this website, Trump Rx, seems like an unusual step toward addressing a very intractable problem.
sentences.zh: 而这个名为“特朗普处方药网”的网站，似乎是解决一个极其顽固的问题的罕见举措。

sentences.en: So, how did the president arrive as this as the solution right now?
sentences.zh: 那么，总统是怎么把这个当作目前的解决方案的呢？

sentences.en: So, I think there's two things going on.
sentences.zh: 所以，我觉得这其中有两个原因。

sentences.en: One is that Trump is obviously under a lot of pressure right now to do something about affordability and particularly about the affordability of health care.
sentences.zh: 一个是特朗普目前显然承受着很大的压力，需要在负担能力上做点什么，特别是医疗保健的负担能力。

sentences.en: Democrats have just been hammering the Trump administration on this and a lot of Americans are concerned about high and rising costs for health care.
sentences.zh: 民主党人一直在这一点上猛烈抨击特朗普政府，而且很多美国人都对医疗保健成本高昂且不断上升感到担忧。

sentences.en: The other thing is that drug prices have sort of been an obsession of Trump's.
sentences.zh: 另一个原因是药价可以说是特朗普的一个情结。

sentences.en: Even from the time he started running for president in 2015, this was something that he would talk about on the campaign trail a lot.
sentences.zh: 甚至从他2015年开始竞选总统的时候起，这就是他在竞选活动中经常谈论的话题。

sentences.en: He almost sounded a little bit like Bernie Sanders on this issue.
sentences.zh: 在这个问题上，他听起来甚至有点像伯尼·桑德斯。

sentences.en: He was always complaining that Americans pay the highest prices for drugs in the world, which is true.
sentences.zh: 他总是抱怨美国人支付的药价是全世界最高的，事实也确实如此。

sentences.en: On average, we pay about three times as much as what other rich countries pay for prescription drugs.
sentences.zh: 平均而言，我们支付的处方药费用大约是其他富裕国家的三倍。

sentences.en: And in his first term, he tried to take some actions to do something about it, but they didn't really work out.
sentences.zh: 在他第一个任期内，他曾试图采取一些行动来解决这个问题，但并没有真正奏效。

sentences.en: And can you just remind us, Margot, why do Americans pay more than other countries for drugs?
sentences.zh: 玛戈，你能提醒一下我们，为什么美国人买药比其他国家贵吗？

sentences.en: So, the answer is a little bit complicated, but I think the simplest way to answer it is that
sentences.zh: 所以，答案有点复杂，但我觉得最简单的回答方式是

sentences.en: most other countries, the government of that country negotiates directly with pharmaceutical companies.
sentences.zh: 在大多数其他国家，该国政府会直接与制药公司进行谈判。

sentences.en: And they say, if you want to sell your drug to all of the patients in my country, you need to give us a good price.
sentences.zh: 他们会说，如果你想把药卖给我国的所有患者，你们就得给我们一个好价格。

sentences.en: We don't have a system like that in the United States.
sentences.zh: 我们美国没有这样的系统。

sentences.en: The government in general is not involved in setting the price for drugs.
sentences.zh: 政府总体上不参与设定药价。

sentences.en: Instead, we have lots of different insurance companies that are making separate deals for different groups of customers.
sentences.zh: 相反，我们有很多不同的保险公司，为不同的客户群体达成单独的协议。

sentences.en: The other difference is that in a lot of other countries, if a drug maker has a new drug that's
sentences.zh: 另一个区别是，在许多其他国家，如果一家药企有一种新药，

sentences.en: really great but really expensive, those countries are willing to say, if you don't bring the price down enough, we are willing to walk away from the negotiating table.
sentences.zh: 真的很好但真的很贵，这些国家愿意说，如果你不把价格降到足够低，我们宁愿退出谈判桌。

sentences.en: Whereas in the United States, I think we have a culture and a politics and an expectation that if a new drug works, that we want to be able to offer it to patients here.
sentences.zh: 而在美国，我认为我们有一种文化、政治和期望，那就是如果一种新药管用，我们就希望能够把它提供给这里的患者。

sentences.en: And so that means that the government, to the degree it's involved, and all of those individual insurance companies just have a little bit less leverage to pull the price down.
sentences.zh: 这意味着政府（在其参与的程度内）以及所有这些独立的保险公司，在压低价格方面的筹码要少一些。

sentences.en: Because they can't walk away from the table, the drug companies have a lot more power here to set whatever price they want for those drugs.
sentences.zh: 因为他们不能退出谈判桌，所以制药公司在这里拥有更大的权力，可以为这些药物设定他们想要的任何价格。

sentences.en: Which, if you think about it, means that we as the United States are in some ways underwriting the cost of drugs for other countries, right?
sentences.zh: 如果你仔细想想，这意味着我们作为美国，在某种程度上是在为其他国家的药费买单，对吧？

sentences.en: Because our country is willing to pay kind of whatever.
sentences.zh: 因为我们的国家愿意付出任何代价。

sentences.en: However, that probably makes it easier for drug companies to go to France or the United
sentences.zh: 然而，这可能让制药公司更容易去法国、英国

sentences.en: Kingdom or wherever else and say, sure, fine, we'll take whatever you're demanding we take for this drug.
sentences.zh: 或其他任何地方说，好吧，行，我们接受你们对这款药提出的任何要求。

sentences.en: I think that's absolutely true.
sentences.zh: 我认为这绝对是真的。

sentences.en: The United States market is incredibly important to the pharmaceutical industry.
sentences.zh: 美国市场对制药行业来说极其重要。

sentences.en: We pay these super high prices.
sentences.zh: 我们支付着超高的价格。

sentences.en: Also, we're just a really big country.
sentences.zh: 而且，我们本来就是个很大的国家。

sentences.en: And so a lot of the business model is sort of predicated on the idea that the drug company is going to make almost all of its money on a new drug in the United States market.
sentences.zh: 所以很多商业模式基本上都建立在这样的理念之上：制药公司将在美国市场上从新药中赚取几乎所有的利润。

sentences.en: And then anything that they get from these other countries is kind of gravy.
sentences.zh: 然后他们从这些其他国家得到的东西某种程度上只是额外红利。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, OK, so you said Trump couldn't bring down the drug prices in his first term.
sentences.zh: 所以，好吧，你刚才说特朗普在第一任期内没能降低药价。

sentences.en: Now he's obviously back in office.
sentences.zh: 现在他显然又回到了办公室。

sentences.en: What has changed?
sentences.zh: 有什么变化？

sentences.en: So one thing that hasn't changed is he's continued to think that this is a really important issue.
sentences.zh: 所以没有改变的一点是，他仍然认为这是一个非常重要的问题。

sentences.en: But here are a few things that are different.
sentences.zh: 但以下几点有所不同。

sentences.en: One is that the market for drugs has changed a little bit.
sentences.zh: 一是药品市场发生了一些变化。

sentences.en: The explosion of these GLP-1 drugs that treat obesity has led to many more consumers buying drugs directly and going around their health insurance.
sentences.zh: 治疗肥胖的GLP-1药物的爆发，导致更多的消费者绕过医疗保险，直接购买药品。

sentences.en: So that's kind of a new consumer market for drugs that didn't exist before.
sentences.zh: 所以这算是一种以前不存在的全新的药品消费市场。

sentences.en: And the other thing is the political pressures around health care affordability that Trump is facing, that Americans feel like health care is too expensive.
sentences.zh: 另一件事是特朗普所面临的关于医疗负担能力的政治压力，美国人觉得医疗保健太贵了。

sentences.en: For example, he had this big campaign promise that he was going to be the father of IVF and he was going to help a lot of couples that were having trouble with fertility make IVF
sentences.zh: 例如，他曾作出一项重大竞选承诺，说自己要成为“试管婴儿之父”，要帮助许多在生育方面遇到困难的夫妇让试管婴儿

sentences.en: more affordable.
sentences.zh: 更加负担得起。

sentences.en: And then on top of that, the Congress, as part of its big tax bill, made major cuts to state Medicaid programs that provide insurance to lots of low-income people.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，国会作为其重大税收法案的一部分，对向大量低收入人群提供保险的国家医疗补助计划进行了大幅削减。

sentences.en: And at the end of last year, Congress allowed subsidies to expire that help millions of Americans buy Obamacare health insurance plans.
sentences.zh: 而在去年年底，国会允许旨在帮助数百万美国人购买奥巴马医改健康保险计划的补贴过期失效。

sentences.en: And so that's increasing the premiums for people who buy that kind of insurance and increasing the number of people who don't have coverage.
sentences.zh: 因此，这推高了购买此类保险的人的保费，并增加了没有医疗保障的人数。

sentences.en: I think all of this is creating pressure for him to try to start to find solutions around rising health care costs.
sentences.zh: 我认为所有这一切都在给他施加压力，让他开始寻找解决医疗成本不断上升的办法。

sentences.en: And here's the thing about prescription drugs.
sentences.zh: 关于处方药，情况是这样的。

sentences.en: They are not the largest cause of health care spending.
sentences.zh: 它们并不是医疗开支的最大原因。

sentences.en: Most of our health care spending goes to pay for hospitalization and doctor's visits.
sentences.zh: 我们的大部分医疗开支都花在了住院和看医生上。

sentences.en: But I think that drug costs are particularly salient for a lot of people because it's the one health care cost that people kind of deal with every single month.
sentences.zh: 但我认为药费对很多人来说尤其突出，因为这是人们每个月都要面对的一种医疗费用。

sentences.en: And so Trump decides that he wants to focus on the pharmaceutical companies and their role in the system.
sentences.zh: 所以特朗普决定将重点放在制药公司及其在系统中所扮演的角色上。

sentences.en: And he begins a pressure campaign on these companies directly.
sentences.zh: 他开始对这些公司直接展开施压行动。

sentences.en: What does that mean?
sentences.zh: 这意味着什么？

sentences.en: Like, what does he actually start doing?
sentences.zh: 比如，他实际上开始做什么了？

sentences.en: So he has his trade officials do an investigation and determine that they can impose major tariffs on pharmaceutical products.
sentences.zh: 所以他让他的贸易官员进行调查，并确定他们可以对医药产品征收重税。

sentences.en: And then he goes to the CEOs of individual pharmaceutical companies.
sentences.zh: 然后他找上了各大制药公司的首席执行官。

sentences.en: And he basically said to them, like, look, I could put a big tariff on you.
sentences.zh: 他基本上对他们说，听着，我对你们征收巨额关税。

sentences.en: I could make it really hard for you to continue to do business in this country.
sentences.zh: 我可以让你们在这个国家继续做生意变得非常困难。

sentences.en: I really need you to make me a deal.
sentences.zh: 我真的很需要你们跟我达成协议。

sentences.en: So he starts negotiating with all these drug companies one at a time.
sentences.zh: 于是他开始逐一与这些药企进行谈判。

sentences.en: And he begins hauling them out in public in front of the cameras to announce deals.
sentences.zh: 他开始把他们拉到公众面前的镜头前宣布达成协议。

sentences.en: I think this is one of the biggest medical announcements that this office has ever made.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是这个办公室有史以来做出的最大医疗公告之一。

sentences.en: So he starts with a drug company, Pfizer.
sentences.zh: 所以他从一家制药公司辉瑞开始。

sentences.en: Pfizer has agreed to provide some of their most popular current medications to all consumers at heavily discounted prices.
sentences.zh: 辉瑞已同意以大幅折扣向所有消费者提供其当前最受欢迎的一些药物。

sentences.en: And he has this press conference with the CEO of that company.
sentences.zh: 他与这家公司的首席执行官召开了这个新闻发布会。

sentences.en: Mr. President, what an honor to be here.
sentences.zh: 总统先生，能来到这里是多么荣幸。

sentences.en: And the press conference, like, it has a little bit of like a hostage video kind of feel to it.
sentences.zh: 这场新闻发布会，感觉有点像那种人质视频。

sentences.en: He has a beautiful office, but the Oval is the coolest, right?
sentences.zh: 他有一个美丽的办公室，但椭圆形办公室才是最酷的，对吧？

sentences.en: What do you think?
sentences.zh: 你觉得呢？

sentences.en: I think by far.
sentences.zh: 我觉得绝对是。

sentences.en: You see the CEO of Pfizer get up in front of the camera and talk about how delighted he is to offer these big discounts on his products.
sentences.zh: 你看到辉瑞的首席执行官站到镜头前，谈论他有多么高兴能为自己的产品提供这些大幅折扣。

sentences.en: Now we have clarity about what is the framework for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 现在我们对美国的定价框架有了清晰的认识。

sentences.en: pricing.
sentences.zh: 定价。

sentences.en: Which, of course, they never would have wanted to do before.
sentences.zh: 这当然是他们以前绝不愿意做的事情。

sentences.en: And going forward, this is how things will be priced in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 展望未来，这就是美国

sentences.en: and abroad.
sentences.zh: 和海外的定价方式。

sentences.en: And it's at that press conference that Trump mentioned the idea of this TrumpRx website.
sentences.zh: 正是在那场新闻发布会上，特朗普提到了这个“特朗普处方药网”的想法。

sentences.en: Drugs will be available for direct purchase online at a website operated by the federal government.
sentences.zh: 药物将通过联邦政府运营的网站在线直接购买。

sentences.en: Where all of these deals are going to be pulled together and made public for the American people to find.
sentences.zh: 所有这些交易都将被汇集在一起并公之于众，供美国人民寻找。

sentences.en: And then over the next weeks and months, one by one...
sentences.zh: 然后在接下来的几周和几个月里，一个接一个……

sentences.en: So, President Trump, it is really a pleasure to see you again since...
sentences.zh: 所以，特朗普总统，自从……以来，再次见到您真的很高兴。

sentences.en: They have executives from numerous drug companies...
sentences.zh: 他们让众多药企的高管……

sentences.en: Mr. President, thank you.
sentences.zh: 总统先生，谢谢您。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 谢谢您，总统先生。

sentences.en: It's a true honor to be here.
sentences.zh: 能来到这里真是无上的荣幸。

sentences.en: ...come out for these press conferences...
sentences.zh: ……出席这些新闻发布会……

sentences.en: We're going to be significantly lowering the cost of the medicines...
sentences.zh: 我们将大幅降低药品的成本……

sentences.en: ...announce these deals and say that they're going to be offering much better pricing to American consumers.
sentences.zh: ……宣布这些交易，并表示他们将为美国消费者提供更好的定价。

sentences.en: And that's a 70% price reduction.
sentences.zh: 那可是70%的降价。

sentences.en: And that also will be available on TrumpRx.
sentences.zh: 这也将在“特朗普处方药网”上提供。

sentences.en: And at each one of these press conferences...
sentences.zh: 而在每一次这样的新闻发布会上……

sentences.en: Now you're going to see numbers that nobody would believe possible.
sentences.zh: 现在你会看到没人敢相信的数字。

sentences.en: Trump is using this incredibly hyperbolic language to describe the kinds of deals that are being offered.
sentences.zh: 特朗普正在使用这种令人难以置信的夸张语言来描述正在提供的交易。

sentences.en: Saying, you know, these are not discounts of 50 or 80%, but they are 700, 800, 1,000% discounts.
sentences.zh: 他说，你知道的，这些不是50%或80%的折扣，而是700%、800%、1000%的折扣。

sentences.en: You're talking about 14, 15, 1,600% reductions in some cases.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，你谈论的是14、15、1600%的降幅。

sentences.en: Discounts that are mathematically not possible.
sentences.zh: 数学上根本不可能实现的折扣。

sentences.en: And I think based on that, I won't even take questions today because there's no way I can take questions that are anywhere comparable to what you just witnessed.
sentences.zh: 我想基于这一点，我今天甚至不接受提问了，因为我不可能接受任何与你刚刚亲眼目睹的相提并论的提问。

sentences.en: You just witnessed drug prices that will go down at levels never thought even possible, Marty.
sentences.zh: 你刚刚见证了药价将降到前所未想的水平，马蒂。

sentences.en: So by the time this website rolls out last week, there's been this drumbeat of press conference after press conference.
sentences.zh: 所以当这个网站在上周推出时，已经经历了一场接一场的新闻发布会的舆论造势。

sentences.en: And I think it's led to this expectation that it's going to be this huge deal and there are going to be all of these wonderful discounts on drugs.
sentences.zh: 我认为这导致了一种期望，即这将是一件大事，而且会有所有这些美妙的药品折扣。

sentences.en: But if you look at the details of these actual deals, the reality is very different than that.
sentences.zh: 但如果你仔细查看这些实际交易的细节，现实情况大不相同。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写《连线》游戏，这是《纽约时报》的益智游戏之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢尝试捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky.
sentences.zh: 我是山姆·阿泽斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天创作《拼字蜜蜂》和《字母宝箱》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做多彩联觉的现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由你刚才听到声音的这些人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com slash games，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: So, Margo,
sentences.zh: 那么，玛戈，

sentences.en: you said before the break that the way that Trump had been talking about this website had set up huge expectations that weren't necessarily met when you actually looked at the deals represented on this site.
sentences.zh: 你在中场休息前说过，特朗普谈论这个网站的方式引发了极高的期望，而当你真正查看该网站上列出的交易时，这些期望并未完全实现。

sentences.en: So tell us a little bit more about what you found when you looked into this more.
sentences.zh: 所以请跟我们多讲讲，当你深入了解这件事时，你发现了什么。

sentences.en: So when you look at this website, it is absolutely not revolutionizing the price of most drugs that most Americans take.
sentences.zh: 当你查看这个网站时，它绝对没有彻底改变绝大多数美国人服用的大多数药物的价格。

sentences.en: First of all, there are only 43 drugs on this website.
sentences.zh: 首先，这个网站上只有 43 种药。

sentences.en: There are thousands and thousands of prescription drugs.
sentences.zh: 处方药有成千上万种。

sentences.en: So this is this tiny, tiny little fraction of the drugs that people need.
sentences.zh: 所以这只是人们需要的药物中极小、极小的一部分。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That is not a lot of the drug market.
sentences.zh: 这并不是药物市场的大部分。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And for people who have insurance, which is 85 percent of all Americans, this website is really not offering them a better price than what they already have.
sentences.zh: 而对于拥有保险的人——占所有美国人的 85%——这个网站提供的价格实际上并不比他们现有的价格更好。

sentences.en: But there are two categories of drugs where the deals are actually pretty good.
sentences.zh: 但有两类药物的交易确实相当不错。

sentences.en: Those are drugs for infertility and for obesity.
sentences.zh: 那是用于治疗不孕不育和肥胖症的药物。

sentences.en: I think we should take a look at this website together and just kind of like walk through what you might actually see.
sentences.zh: 我想我们应该一起看一看这个网站，顺便了解一下你实际会看到什么。

sentences.en: Yeah, let's do it.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们来看看。

sentences.en: So I'm going to go to TrumpRx.gov.
sentences.zh: 所以我要访问 TrumpRx.gov。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's the website.
sentences.zh: 就是那个网站。

sentences.en: I'm going there, too.
sentences.zh: 我也正在访问。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So the first thing that I see is in big letters, it says find the world's lowest prices on prescription drugs.
sentences.zh: 我看到的第一件事是用大写字母写着：寻找全球最低的处方药价格。

sentences.en: And there's like a little pill instead of a period after the word drugs.
sentences.zh: 在“药物”这个词后面，有一个小药丸代替了句号。

sentences.en: There's a vial kind of hovering over the word prices.
sentences.zh: “价格”这个词上方悬浮着一个小药瓶。

sentences.en: And let's see.
sentences.zh: 我们来看看。

sentences.en: You can scroll down.
sentences.zh: 你可以向下滚动。

sentences.en: We see comparisons between the USA and Canada.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了美国和加拿大的对比。

sentences.en: OK, so keep going, though, because this is my favorite part.
sentences.zh: 好的，不过继续往下看，因为这是我最喜欢的部分。

sentences.en: There's a spinning globe with the United States in gold.
sentences.zh: 有一个旋转的地球仪，上面金色的美国闪闪发光。

sentences.en: It's very catching.
sentences.zh: 非常吸引眼球。

sentences.en: And it says, thanks to President Trump, the days of big pharma price gouging are over.
sentences.zh: 上面写着：感谢特朗普总统，大型制药公司哄抬物价的日子已经一去不复返了。

sentences.en: Leveraging the full weight and power of the United States of America,
sentences.zh: 凭借美利坚合众国的全部威严和力量，

sentences.en: the president has ensured every American gets the lowest prices on prescription medications in the developed world.
sentences.zh: 总统已确保每位美国人都能获得发达世界中最低的处方药价格。

sentences.en: You know, I think it's a very beautiful website.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为这是一个非常漂亮的网站。

sentences.en: The design is very clean.
sentences.zh: 设计非常干净。

sentences.en: It's enjoyable.
sentences.zh: 让人看着舒服。

sentences.en: It's easy to understand.
sentences.zh: 通俗易懂。

sentences.en: But it is continuing to make these very hyperbolic promises that it really just doesn't deliver on.
sentences.zh: 但它一直在做出这些非常夸张的承诺，而实际上根本无法兑现。

sentences.en: OK, so let's look at the actual drugs.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们来看看实际的药物。

sentences.en: I'm going to scroll down until I find a drug.
sentences.zh: 我向下滚动直到找到一种药。

sentences.en: OK, so the first drug listed here is Wegovi, a weight loss medication, right?
sentences.zh: 好的，这里列出的第一种药是 Wegovi，一种减肥药，对吧？

sentences.en: Margot, tell me what we are looking at.
sentences.zh: 玛戈，告诉我我们看到的是什么。

sentences.en: So Wegovi, this is one of these GLP-1 drugs.
sentences.zh: 所以 Wegovi 是这些 GLP-1 药物之一。

sentences.en: This is a drug that is used to treat obesity.
sentences.zh: 这是一种用于治疗肥胖症的药物。

sentences.en: And it says WegoviPen 74% to 85% off.
sentences.zh: 上面写着 Wegovi 笔式注射器，七四折到八五折。

sentences.en: And then there's this little chart that shows you, depending on what dose of the drug you're going to buy, what is the price.
sentences.zh: 然后有一个小图表显示，根据你购买的药物剂量，价格是多少。

sentences.en: So the list price for this drug is more than $1,000 a month.
sentences.zh: 这种药的标价是一个月 1000 多美元。

sentences.en: On this website, it says original price $1,349.02.
sentences.zh: 在这个网站上，它显示原价为 1,349.02 美元。

sentences.en: That is what you would have to pay at the pharmacy, $1,350 a month.
sentences.zh: 这就是你在药店必须支付的价格，一个月 1,350 美元。

sentences.en: And with the TrumpRx pricing, what they are showing you is for the highest dose of the drug, the price is only $349.
sentences.zh: 而通过 TrumpRx 定价，他们向你展示的是，对于最高剂量的药物，价格仅为 349 美元。

sentences.en: So this is some really significant savings for people who take this drug, don't have insurance coverage for it, and are paying with their own money out of pocket.
sentences.zh: 因此，对于那些服用这种药、没有医疗保险且自掏腰包的人来说，这确实省下了不少钱。

sentences.en: I want to look at some of the other drugs on this website because I noticed that a lot of the drugs listed of these 43 are fertility drugs,
sentences.zh: 我想看看这个网站上的其他一些药物，因为我注意到这 43 种列出的药物中有很多是生育药物，

sentences.en: which are drugs that people often have to pay for out of pocket.
sentences.zh: 这些药物通常需要人们自掏腰包购买。

sentences.en: And I'd actually asked a girlfriend of mine who recently went through IVF to send me the list of drugs she had to purchase out of pocket from an online pharmacy recently because I wanted to compare the prices that she paid to the prices being advertised on TrumpRx.
sentences.zh: 我其实请了一位最近做过试管婴儿的女性朋友，把她最近不得不从网上药店自费购买的药物清单发给我，因为我想把她支付的价格与 TrumpRx 上宣传的价格进行比较。

sentences.en: My friend paid about $300 for it, and if we just type it into TrumpRx, we can see that it starts at the same dosage that she had for $168.
sentences.zh: 我朋友大约花了 300 美元，如果我们把药名输入 TrumpRx，就会发现她用的那种剂量起步价只要 168 美元。

sentences.en: So that's a significant discount.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个相当大的折扣。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think your friend's price is kind of illustrative, right?
sentences.zh: 是的，我觉得你朋友支付的价格很有说明意义，对吧？

sentences.en: The TrumpRx website is saying that the original price was $966.
sentences.zh: TrumpRx 网站声称原价是 966 美元。

sentences.en: Your friend was paying around $300.
sentences.zh: 你朋友支付的大约是 300 美元。

sentences.en: So this is a big savings, $168 is less than $300.
sentences.zh: 所以这确实省了一大笔钱，168 美元确实比 300 美元少。

sentences.en: I think for these fertility drugs, it's another example where the Trump administration did negotiate better discounts than were available before.
sentences.zh: 我认为对于这些生育药物来说，这是特朗普政府谈判达成的折扣确实比以前更好的又一个例子。

sentences.en: And I do think that the reduced costs of some of these infertility drugs is going to make these treatments more affordable for women who need them.
sentences.zh: 而且我确实认为，其中一些不孕不育药物成本的降低，将使有需要的女性更能负担得起这些治疗。

sentences.en: But it is not quite as big as what the website is promising.
sentences.zh: 但它并没有网站承诺的那么优惠。

sentences.en: So if you think about obesity drugs and infertility drugs, these two examples are the places where TrumpRx is actually doing the most work.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你想想减肥药和不孕不育药物，这两个例子就是 TrumpRx 真正发挥最大作用的地方。

sentences.en: Okay, weight loss drugs, IVF drugs, got it.
sentences.zh: 好的，减肥药，试管婴儿药，明白了。

sentences.en: But what about literally everything else?
sentences.zh: 那其他所有药物呢？

sentences.en: So the literally everything else is a little bit more disappointing.
sentences.zh: 所以其他所有药物就有点让人失望了。

sentences.en: And here's why.
sentences.zh: 原因如下。

sentences.en: These other drugs are the kinds of drugs that treat more common conditions like asthma, high cholesterol, diabetes.
sentences.zh: 这些其他药物是用于治疗更常见疾病的药物，比如哮喘、高胆固醇、糖尿病。

sentences.en: These are the kinds of drugs that almost everyone's insurance covers really well.
sentences.zh: 这些都是几乎所有人的保险都能提供极好报销的药物。

sentences.en: And so if you have insurance, then you're not paying the full price.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你有保险，你就不用支付全价。

sentences.en: You're paying a copayment, which in many cases could be like $25 a month.
sentences.zh: 你只需要支付共付额，在许多情况下，可能也就是一个月 25 美元左右。

sentences.en: That's pretty much going to beat the TrumpRx price for all of these drugs.
sentences.zh: 这基本上比所有这些药物的 TrumpRx 价格都要便宜。

sentences.en: And 85% of Americans have insurance coverage that covers their drugs.
sentences.zh: 而且 85% 的美国人拥有可以报销药费的医疗保险。

sentences.en: So that really is most people.
sentences.zh: 所以这确实涵盖了绝大多数人。

sentences.en: Then even if you're thinking about the people who don't have insurance and who have to pay for their drugs directly with cash,
sentences.zh: 然后，即使你考虑到那些没有保险、必须直接用现金支付药费的人，

sentences.en: my colleague Rebecca Robbins and I went through this list of drugs.
sentences.zh: 我和我的同事丽贝卡·罗宾斯仔细查阅了这份药物清单。

sentences.en: And of the 43 drugs, we found that about half of them already have generics that are on the market that are cheaper than the prices that are being offered on TrumpRx.
sentences.zh: 在这 43 种药物中，我们发现大约有一半已经有仿制药上市，其价格比 TrumpRx 上提供的价格还要便宜。

sentences.en: So even for those people who don't have insurance, they would not be better off buying the drugs through this system.
sentences.zh: 因此，即使对于那些没有保险的人来说，通过这个系统买药也不会更划算。

sentences.en: They would be better off going to their pharmacy and just paying for a generic.
sentences.zh: 他们直接去药店买仿制药会更好。

sentences.en: Can it be clear to people that this website might not give them the best deal for the drug that they're looking for?
sentences.zh: 能不能向人们明确说明，这个网站可能无法为他们寻找的药物提供最优惠的价格？

sentences.en: The website has some disclaimers on it.
sentences.zh: 该网站上有一些免责声明。

sentences.en: When you go on each individual page, you will see that there is a disclaimer, for example,
sentences.zh: 当你访问每一个单独的页面时，你会看到一条免责声明，例如，

sentences.en: that you should check and see if you have insurance, it might be cheaper with a copayment.
sentences.zh: 你应该检查一下自己是否有保险，通过共付额购买可能会更便宜。

sentences.en: So this is not a one-stop shop for people.
sentences.zh: 所以这并不是一个能满足人们所有需求的一站式商店。

sentences.en: And even the people who have designed this TrumpRx website acknowledge that and are telling consumers that.
sentences.zh: 甚至设计这个 TrumpRx 网站的人也承认这一点，并正在告诉消费者。

sentences.en: At the same time, though, let's just be honest about the amount of time and resources people have to investigate their own health care.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，让我们实话实说，人们调查自身医疗保健所拥有的时间和资源是有限的。

sentences.en: Like if you are working full time, if you are a caregiver, if you are working multiple jobs,
sentences.zh: 比如，如果你是全职工作，如果你是照顾者，如果你身兼数职，

sentences.en: the amount of time that you're likely to invest in whether you can get the cheapest drug by like looking this up,
sentences.zh: 你可能会投入多少时间去查阅、查看保险等信息，以此来确定自己能不能买到最便宜的药，

sentences.en: looking at your insurance, et cetera, et cetera, is probably kind of limited.
sentences.zh: 这种时间可能相当有限。

sentences.en: So if you have the general impression from the press conferences we talked about or others that this is going to be the cheapest version of the way that you get your drugs,
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你从我们讨论过的那些或其他新闻发布会上得到普遍印象，认为这将是你买药最便宜的方式，

sentences.en: you might just end up using TrumpRx, right, even if it's not actually the best deal.
sentences.zh: 你最后可能就会直接使用 TrumpRx，对吧，即使它实际上并不是最优惠的。

sentences.en: You might, but I think that most Americans actually are used to using their insurance for drugs.
sentences.zh: 你可能会，但我认为大多数美国人实际上已经习惯了用保险来买药。

sentences.en: They're not used to paying directly with cash and shopping around for the best price in the way that this website is encouraging them to do.
sentences.zh: 他们不习惯像这个网站鼓励的那样，直接用现金支付并在各处比价以寻找最低价格。

sentences.en: But some people that we talked to said that they're worried people are going to think
sentences.zh: 但我们交谈过的一些人表示，他们担心人们会以为

sentences.en: that TrumpRx is offering them the best deal and they are not going to look into these other options and they're going to end up overpaying for drugs.
sentences.zh: TrumpRx 提供的是最优惠的价格，因而不会再去了解其他选择，最终导致买药花冤枉钱。

sentences.en: So the bottom line here, it seems, from everything you've said, is that if you have trouble paying for your prescription drugs in the United States,
sentences.zh: 所以，综合你所说的一切，这里的核心结论似乎是，如果你在美国支付处方药费用有困难，

sentences.en: this website is probably not going to fix that problem.
sentences.zh: 这个网站可能无法解决这个问题。

sentences.en: Yeah, this website just isn't really doing very much for most Americans who struggle with their prescription drug prices.
sentences.zh: 是的，对于大多数在处方药价格上挣扎的美国人来说，这个网站其实并没有起到多大作用。

sentences.en: For example, some of the most expensive drugs on the market right now and the ones that Americans and insurance companies struggle to pay for are drugs for cancer.
sentences.zh: 例如，目前市场上一些最昂贵的药物，以及美国人和保险公司难以承担费用的药物，是治疗癌症的药物。

sentences.en: There are not any drugs for cancer on this website.
sentences.zh: 这个网站上没有任何抗癌药物。

sentences.en: And it's worth noting that this is just the beginning.
sentences.zh: 值得一提的是，这仅仅是个开始。

sentences.en: More drugs are expected to be added to this website over time.
sentences.zh: 预计随着时间的推移，会有更多药物被添加到这个网站上。

sentences.en: But for right now, it's very clear that this is not the solution to the problem of high prescription drug costs in America.
sentences.zh: 但就目前而言，很明显这并不是解决美国高处方药成本问题的办法。

sentences.en: So, Margot, if this website is really only going to help people who either want to lose weight
sentences.zh: 那么，玛戈，如果这个网站真的只能帮助那些要么想减肥

sentences.en: or have more children, it does make me wonder about the decision to focus on those two groups to begin with, especially because candidate Trump made growing the American family
sentences.zh: 要么想多生孩子的人，这确实让我对最初专注于这两个群体的决定产生怀疑，特别是考虑到候选人特朗普将发展美利坚大家庭

sentences.en: such a big part of his campaign.
sentences.zh: 作为其竞选活动的重要组成部分。

sentences.en: Do you think that this Trump-Rx program is motivated more by ideology and perhaps campaign promises than by a desire to truly improve affordability?
sentences.zh: 你认为这个特朗普处方药计划更多是出于意识形态和竞选承诺的动机，而不是出于真正提高负担能力的愿望吗？

sentences.en: I don't really think it is.
sentences.zh: 我真的不觉得是这样。

sentences.en: I think it's more of a happy accident that these are drugs that Trump would love to take credit
sentences.zh: 我认为这更像是一个幸的巧合，即这些正是特朗普乐于居功的药物，

sentences.en: for lowering the price of because they connect to his campaign promises in the case of infertility and they're really popular in the case of weight loss drugs.
sentences.zh: 因为在不孕不育的情况下，它们契合了他的竞选承诺，而在减肥药的情况下，它们非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: But there are also drugs where the drug company already had a pretty big incentive to offer a discount
sentences.zh: 但这也是一些制药公司本身就已经有很大动力提供折扣的药物，

sentences.en: that there is this big market of people who are already paying for it with their own money.
sentences.zh: 因为存在着一个庞大的、已经自掏腰包购买这些药物的市场。

sentences.en: And the publicity of the Trump-Rx launch might help bring them more customers that will compensate for the lower prices.
sentences.zh: 而且 TrumpRx 推出的宣传可能会帮助他们吸引更多客户，从而弥补降价带来的损失。

sentences.en: But the whole exercise, I think, very much fits into the kind of salesmanship that we expect from Trump.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，整个行动非常符合我们对特朗普的那种推销风格的预期。

sentences.en: He does not really have a solution to the broader question of health care affordability.
sentences.zh: 对于医疗保健负担能力的更广泛问题，他其实并没有解决方案。

sentences.en: He does not have a comprehensive plan to lower health care costs at the hospital or at doctors or any of the other places where most Americans are faced with the biggest bills.
sentences.zh: 他没有一个全面的计划来降低医院、医生或大多数美国人面临巨额账单的其他任何地方的医疗成本。

sentences.en: And even more than that, his administration has taken actions that are raising the cost of health care
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，他的政府还采取了种种行动，抬高了许多美国人的

sentences.en: for a lot of Americans that could cause millions of Americans to lose their health insurance.
sentences.zh: 医疗成本，这可能导致数百万美国人失去医疗保险。

sentences.en: So this is not just a small solution, but it is a small solution to a problem that is getting worse on Trump's watch.
sentences.zh: 所以这不仅是一个小打小闹的解决方案，而且它试图解决的问题在特朗普的眼皮底下还在不断恶化。

sentences.en: Margo Singer-Katz, thank you again for being with us today.
sentences.zh: 玛戈·辛格-卡茨，再次感谢你今天做客我们的节目。

sentences.en: It's nice to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: During a congressional hearing on Tuesday, Todd Lyons, the acting ICE director,
sentences.zh: 在周二举行的国会听证会上，移民和海关执法局（ICE）代理局长托德·莱昂斯

sentences.en: refused to say whether anyone had been fired after an ICE agent shot and killed Renee Good in Minnesota last month.
sentences.zh: 拒绝透露上个月在明尼苏达州发生 ICE 特工开枪打死蕾妮·古德一事后，是否有人被解雇。

sentences.en: Can you tell us if at least, God, I hope at least one person has been fired for their conduct since these operations have begun?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我们，自从这些行动开始以来，上帝啊，我希望至少有一个人因为他们的行为而被解雇了吗？

sentences.en: Are you telling us you can't even say one person's been fired?
sentences.zh: 你是说你连一个人被解雇了都不能说吗？

sentences.en: Sure, I'm not going to talk about personnel actions, but we will get back to you.
sentences.zh: 当然，我不会讨论人事处理决定，但我们会回复你们的。

sentences.en: The Trump administration had labeled Good a domestic terrorist in the immediate aftermath of her death.
sentences.zh: 在古德死后不久，特朗普政府将其定性为国内恐怖分子。

sentences.en: When pressed, Lyons refused to apologize for the label and declined to answer whether it was true.
sentences.zh: 在追问之下，莱昂斯拒绝为这一标签道歉，并拒绝回答这是否属实。

sentences.en: And a shooter killed nine people and injured 25 others in a remote town in northeastern British Columbia, the third deadliest shooting in Canada's history.
sentences.zh: 一名枪手在不列颠哥伦比亚省东北部的一个偏远小镇枪杀 9 人并打伤 25 人，这是加拿大历史上第三大严重枪击事件。

sentences.en: Seven people were found dead in Tumblr Ridge Secondary School, including a person believed to be the shooter, who died from what appeared to be a self-inflicted injury.
sentences.zh: 人们在特姆布勒里奇中学的校园里发现了 7 具尸体，其中包括一名被认为是枪手的人，死于疑似自残的伤势。

sentences.en: Two other people were found dead in a local residence, while another person died while being transported to a hospital.
sentences.zh: 另有两人被发现在当地一处住宅中身亡，还有一人在被送往医院的途中死亡。

sentences.en: A motive for the attack was not immediately clear, and authorities have not released details about the shooter.
sentences.zh: 袭击动机尚不明确，当局也未公布有关枪手的细节。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Alex Stern, Rob Zipko, Anna Foley, and Diana Nguyen.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由亚历克斯·斯特恩、罗布·齐普科、安娜·弗利和戴安娜·阮制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Lexi Dio and MJ Davis-Lynn.
sentences.zh: 由莱克西·迪奥和 MJ·戴维斯-林恩剪辑。

sentences.en: Contains music by Marian Lozano and Diane Wong.
sentences.zh: 包含玛丽安·洛扎诺和黛安·王创作的音乐。

sentences.en: And was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 本期节目由克里斯·伍德（Chris Wood）工程制作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Rachel AbraMs.
sentences.zh: 我是雷切尔·艾布拉姆斯。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我们明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目中，我们将为假期招待客做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人们宾至如归的实用小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种对光线极度敏感、需要绝对黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我指的不是那种喝断片儿了才睡着的人。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有什么过敏史或饮食禁忌吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们习惯喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》应用程序或您常用的播客平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。
